decision_question: Is the supplied input sufficient to register bench BENCH-PGD-B1-01 and open its round plan?
hypothesis: BENCH-PGD-B1-01 records its availability windows, cycle time and per-run cost sufficient for later slot planning, and CMP-PGD-B1-001 records its rounds, their stop states and its paired design, so the inner loop can run up to 12 bench rounds.
uncertainty: Supplied availability, cycle time and cost are not independently verified; recorded ASSUMED evidence remains assumed and this record does not reserve capacity, book a run, or establish a capability conclusion. The plan's rounds are recorded as they happened, and a later round's outcome is not known before it runs.
decision_rule: Register the bench and open its round plan only when availability windows, a positive cycle time, per-run cost with source, a recorded pairing design, and evidence without GAP are supplied; the cross-field ledger rules (current_iteration within max_iterations, only CONTINUE authorizes another round, exit-round-only model/next-batch references) are enforced by the validator.
result: BENCH-PGD-B1-01 is sufficient to register a bench record; available_bench_slots=12; no round recorded yet (the ledger stands at round 1 of 12, max_iterations=12, defaulted from contracts/state-machine.json).
next_action: Open bench round 1 of 12 with the pairing design recorded above.
